acceptance_criteria.description: The dependency pilot is complete with a durable standalone-verified exploratory report before sampling is preregistered.
Case denominator, repetitions, ordering, budgets, metrics and uncertainty method are frozen before observing sampling outputs.
Every planned case and repetition has a retained terminal attempt state; missing and invalid attempts are not silently filtered.
The persisted repeated-sampling report and statistics receipts pass standalone verification without being promoted beyond their valid evidence label.

objective: Only after the single-case exploratory pilot is reproducible and independently verified, freeze a real Terminal-Bench case denominator and repetition count and run repeated sampling with every planned terminal state retained.
title: Run preregistered Magenta repeated sampling after the pilot
